notes.title: Missions Update
notes.notes:
Attention all Cleaner units,
Operation Survive has reached a major update revolving around the missions, main menu fix, and settings using .json format, UI responsiveness, graphics + sounds

What to expect in this update
[list]
[*] +4 AI Bots (Simplified but they follow and revive)
[*] 2 annihilation missions
[*] 2 mission maps
[*] Base Menu Update
[*] Stages 0 and 1 added
[*] Day and Night on certain maps
[*] Support Calls (A new system that has been made to call for supplies, weapons or reinforcements)
[*] Working minimap
[*] Health and damage balancing
[*] Optimized (to the best of my ability) for faster FPS
[/list]

And more to come as we continue the journey!

You can catch video updates on our [b]Youtube Channel[/b] at: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@griffoninteractive]Griffon Interactive[/url]

Stay Safe 
-Griffon Interactive Director



Directors note: The update came a day later than Halloween which was advertised but we missed it due to some bugs that took a day to fix. But otherwise, we are happy to show off what we got for the October-November timeline!
We have been working hard to make this game worthy of the price tag and worthy of our debut in the game development environment. We appreciate not only your feedback but also the time that you have given to support us! 
We will continue to update this game until the day we officially release it, not on Early Access, but officially released!
There are more things to do and as we continue, the updates will be posted. 
Hype is what we need and we would appreciate it if you could give us your support from you and or friends and family!

notes.title: UPDATE New Content and story mode WIP!
notes.notes:
Attention all Cleaner units, Operation Survive after the first announcement of the game mechanic redesign, we have also worked on improvements to the overall quality of the game such as, 

[list]
[*] Updated Main Menu
[*] Universal AI Faction and strafing AI
[*] New weapon to Arsenal: M249 Machine Gun
[*] Day and Night cycle (ONLY IN THE OPEN WORLD PORTION)
[*] Just a small glimpse into the WIP story of Cleaner 159 and the journey to Earth after the Alien invasion catastrophe. 
[*] UI Responsive (UI has click sounds so it feels more lively)
[*] Graphics and Sound settings
[/list]

And more to come!

you can catch video updates on our [b]Youtube Channel[/b] at: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@griffoninteractive]Griffon Interactive[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897256/d746d322235e804898f7694848d4019f7eb7a341.png[/img]

Even though there have not been any exciting updates to the game, know that our team is working very hard to ensure YOU the player will have an amazing experience. 
The team has not abandoned this game nor abandoned you!
We will try to update more consistently to show progress and our roadmap that is coming up!


We will be giving this game the first demo hopefully by the end of August - beginning of October 2024. 
This is our first big game project and we hope that you will enjoy the product!


Stay Safe
-Griffon Interactive Director 

Directors note: military life while game development is gonna be difficult but it will work. For the ones still waiting on this game, we appreciate your support and patience throughout this ordeal.

notes.title: Hotfix 01

Happy hunting Cleaners,
Spearhead Interactive Director
